title: Piyush's Projects and Builds
content: Piyush has worked on several projects and builds including a job automation pipeline using n8n, a Mandelbrot explorer in WebGL/GLSL, a private habit tracker web app on Netlify, a Node.js machine pipeline simulation engine, and a book on consciousness. He is also interested in multi-agent AI systems, n8n, and CrewAI. Piyush is developing a documentary-style content series called 'Grow with Me' and has a self-hosted second brain called Cogni, which ingests YouTube history and ChatGPT/Claude chats. He is also writing a 20-chapter book on architecture of mind, focusing on attention, memory, learning, and meaning.
raw_text:
- n8n job automation pipeline (Gmail trigger, cover letters, Sheets tracker, Telegram notifications)
- Mandelbrot explorer in WebGL/GLSL
- Private habit tracker web app on Netlify (auth, analytics, CSV/JSON export, full v2 rebuild)
- Node.js machine pipeline simulation engine modeling backpressure and blocking
- Wrote and self-published a book on consciousness, comparison and personal philosophy
- Writing *Architecture of Mind: An Engineer's Framework for Understanding Attention, Memory, Learning, and Meaning*, a 20-chapter book mapping systems architecture onto cognition (Preface, four parts, closing chapter on model limitations). Strongest ideas: "emotion as save button" and the "Automatic Mode" pipeline. Underdeveloped: the "Life" component and attention
- Instagram carousel concept framing the mind as a software architecture
- Story in development: a violent dissociative episode (Arohi attacking Vishnu) is the last "real" event, and everything after is implied to happen inside Vishnu's coma
- Interested in multi-agent AI systems, n8n, CrewAI
- "Grow with Me" documentary-style content series (lead with the viewer's feeling, not a personal update)
- Cogni: self-hosted second brain on the spare laptop (16GB RAM, GTX 1080 4GB, 256GB SSD + 1TB HDD), 24x7, local only, ingesting YouTube history and ChatGPT/Claude chats. Dev laptop is 8GB RAM, Ryzen 5, integrated graphics
